country.title: Country code
country.description: Must match the country/region in the Eufy app (e.g. IL, US, DE).

pollingIntervalMinutes.title: Device refresh interval (minutes)
pollingIntervalMinutes.description: How often to refresh after cameras are found. While empty, retries every 60 seconds.

mfaCode.title: MFA / 2FA code
mfaCode.description: Only when Eufy emails/SMS a login code. Clear after a successful connect.

captchaCode.title: Captcha answer
captchaCode.description: 4-character answer from captcha.png in the plugin persist folder. Clear after success.

ffmpegPath.title: Custom ffmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: Optional. Defaults to ffmpeg-for-homebridge, then system ffmpeg.
